title: Looker Scheduled Delivery Failures
dataSources: Looker System Activity (`history`, `pdt_builds`, `scheduled_plan`, `event`, `api_usage`), Looker API queue/PDT metrics, GCP audit logs for Looker Studio and BigQuery-backed reports.
app: Looker System Activity and Admin API via HEC scripted inputs; Looker Studio and BigQuery-backed usage via the Splunk Add-on for Google Cloud Platform (`Splunk_TA_google-cloudplatform`).
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=looker:system_activity view=scheduled_plan
| stats count as runs, sum(eval(status="failure")) as failures by scheduled_plan_name, destination_type
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Monitors Looker scheduled deliveries (email, Slack, webhook, storage) and surfaces schedules failing to deliver so stakeholders keep getting their reports.
value: Silent delivery failures leave decision-makers without their expected reports; catching them preserves trust in automated Looker distributions.
implementation: Query `scheduled_plan` System Activity; schedule hourly; alert on repeated failures per destination.
visualization: Table of failing schedules, timechart of delivery failures.
grandmaExplanation: We make sure the automatic Looker report emails and messages actually go out, so nobody is left waiting for one that failed.
